blocks.note: Keep a relative clause beside its antecedent and use verb-subject order where it prevents a long subject from stranding the main verb.
Form direct questions, then preserve their internal verb-subject order when embedding them as indirect questions; all implicit-answer continuations remain excluded.
Convert statements into exclamations with an accented exclamative and the neutral order appropriate to the focused predicate or quantity.
Keep each governing preposition before its relative form while completing compact definitions.
Use the printed answer key to identify the misplaced adverb in each otherwise structurally ambiguous multiple-choice item.
